name: Henty

climate: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Riesling sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: Australia's Geographical Indications nest in three levels: zones, the regions inside them, and subregions inside those.

blurb.text: One of the cooler Australian regions, in the Western Victoria area in the southwest corner of the state, formerly called Drumborg.
